title: When Should Deployed BCI Decoders Adapt? A Resource-Priced Ladder for Frozen EEG Trunks
abstract: arXiv:2611.25315v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: When should a deployed MI decoder spend adaptation resources-not only how to adapt under shift? We study a thin control layer outside a frozen encoder: a resource ladder (factory -> Bayesian head -> affine map, with full fine-tune as an escape hatch) governed by regime-aware gating under a utility that prices accuracy, fit time, and label cost. The head is Bayesian in the conjugate sense: a Normal-Inverse-Wishart prior over the class conditional Gaussians in embedding space, updated in closed form (no gradients) as labelled trials arrive. Full estimators, constants, and the reanalysis code are in the companion paper and the ancillary bundle of this submission. Thesis: adaptation should be gated and capped, not always-on and not blindly fine-tuned. Evidence: (i) utility-max gating over-adapts on clean data that already carries session drift; a clean-referenced gate restores low false-entry rates (e.g. dropping the adaptation rate from 0

translated_title: 已部署的脑机接口解码器何时应该自适应？面向冻结EEG主干的资源定价阶梯
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.25315v1 公告类型：交叉列表 摘要：已部署的运动想象（MI）解码器何时应该投入自适应资源——而不仅仅是在分布偏移下如何自适应？我们研究了冻结编码器之外的一个轻量控制层：一个资源阶梯（出厂模型 -> 贝叶斯头 -> 仿射映射，并以完整微调作为最后的逃生通道），由情境感知门控（regime-aware gating）管理，其效用函数对准确率、拟合时间和标注成本进行定价。该头部是共轭意义上的贝叶斯：在嵌入空间中对类条件高斯分布采用正态-逆威沙特（Normal-Inverse-Wishart）先验，随着标注试验数据的到来以闭式形式更新（无需梯度计算）。完整的估计器、常数以及再分析代码见配套论文和本提交的辅助文件包。核心论点：自适应应当被门控并设定上限，而不是始终开启，也不是盲目微调。证据：（i）效用最大化门控在已经携带会话漂移的干净数据上会过度自适应；一个以干净数据为参照的门控可以恢复较低的误进入率（例如，将自适应率从0……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文针对冻结的EEG编码器提出一个由情境感知门控与效用定价（准确率、拟合时间和标注成本）驱动的资源阶梯自适应控制层，通过闭式贝叶斯头部更新，证明已部署BCI解码器的自适应应当被门控并设定上限，而非始终开启或盲目微调。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a resource-priced ladder control layer outside a frozen EEG encoder—governed by regime-aware gating under a utility pricing accuracy, fit time, and label cost, with closed-form Bayesian head updates—showing that adaptation of deployed BCI decoders should be gated and capped rather than always-on or blindly fine-tuned.
